hints.check: Making sure everything is ready before generating.
hints.rules: Choose how the game is played.
hints.host: Choose where the game server runs.

load.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. You can start a new one.

new.title: New game
new.body: Give it a name: you will add the players right after.

players.dropTitle: Drop the players’ YAML files here
players.dropHint: .yaml, .yml or .txt files, or a .zip of YAML files
players.title: Players
players.emptyBody: Each player sends you their YAML: drop them all here.
players.ignoredBody: These are not player YAML files: they were not added.
players.needPlayers: Add at least one YAML to continue.

check.readyBody: Nothing blocking: you can move on to the rules.
check.readyWarnings: Nothing blocking, but have a look at the warnings below.
check.blockedUnknown: Cannot continue: the check reports a blocking problem.
check.worldsBody: No installed world handles these games.
check.notInCatalog: Not in the catalog: ask the player for the .apworld file.
check.romsBody: These games need their ROM to be generated. It stays on your PC: nothing is downloaded or shared.

rename.title: Rename {{name}}
rename.label: New name
rename.hint: 16 characters at most, different from the other players’ names.
rename.numeric: A name cannot be made of digits only.
rename.multiDoc: The other players of this file are kept as they are.
rename.unreadable: This file cannot be read back here: fix it in the Studio.

casual.title: Casual
casual.body: With friends: cheap hints, and each world releases its items when its player is done.

async.title: Async
async.body: Over several days: the server never stops on its own, everyone plays at their pace.

race.title: Race
race.body: For a competition: no spoiler, race mode and the same version for everyone.

rules.passwordHint: Asked from every player to connect. Empty: no password.
rules.serverPasswordHint: To run the server remotely (!admin). Empty: disabled.
rules.secretsUnavailable: The saved passwords could not be read back.
rules.hintCostHint: As a % of the world’s locations: 10 gives a hint every 10%.
rules.locationCheckPointsHint: The points that pay for hints.
rules.releaseModeHint: Sends the items left in your world to the other players.
rules.collectModeHint: Grabs at once your items left in the other worlds.
rules.countdownHint: Auto: allowed under 30 players. The host can always run /countdown.
rules.itemCheatHint: Players can give themselves items: that is cheating.
rules.spoilerHint: Basic: where each item is. Playthrough: plus a solution. Full: plus the path to each item.
rules.raceHint: Flags the game as a race; games that support it encrypt their ROMs.
rules.autoShutdownHint: Stops the server after this long without a new location checked. 0: never.
rules.compatibilityHint: Exact version: every client must run exactly the server’s version.
rules.plandoHint: What the YAML files may place by hand.

generate.idleBody: Archipelago reads the YAML files, spreads the items across every world and prepares one file per player. It takes from a few seconds to a few minutes.
generate.stalled: No progress for 10 minutes — big seeds can take a while; you can cancel.
generate.cancelledBody: Nothing was kept. Start again whenever you like.
generate.successBody: Every player has a slot. All that is left is hosting the game.

host.noGenerationBody: Generate the game before choosing where to host it.

web.title: archipelago.gg
web.body: Archipelago’s official site runs the server for you.
web.pointSetup: Nothing to set up on your router
web.pointConnect: Players connect to archipelago.gg, on a port the site gives
web.pointSleep: The room sleeps when nobody plays; one click wakes it up

local.title: On this PC
local.badge: LAN, or the Internet with port forwarding
local.body: The server runs here, as long as the app stays open.
local.pointLan: Great when everyone is on the same network
local.pointPort: For the Internet: forward the server’s TCP port on your router
local.pointConsole: You keep control of the server console

consent.title: Host on archipelago.gg?
consent.intro: The generated game (its zip file) will be sent to archipelago.gg, which will run the server.
consent.passwords: The zip holds the game’s passwords in plain text: the site can read them.
consent.public: Anyone who has the link can reach the room.
consent.eachTime: This question comes back every time you host on the site.
